verticalFaqs.question: Does Chiefy handle insurance and waiver questions?
verticalFaqs.answer: Yes. Chiefy learns your rider requirements — liability insurance, age restrictions, waiver details, what riders need to bring. When someone emails asking what they need before their tour, Chiefy drafts a complete response with all the specifics. You review and tap send.

verticalFaqs.question: I'm on the trail all day with no cell service. How does Chiefy help?
verticalFaqs.answer: That's exactly why guides love Chiefy. While you're leading a 6-8 hour tour with no signal, booking inquiries pile up. Chiefy drafts replies to every one of them — pricing, availability, meeting location, what to wear. When you get back, you review the drafts and send. Most guides tell us it saves them 1-2 hours of email time per day during peak season.

pricingNote: At $200/machine, one saved group of 4 pays for over a year of Pro.
